## Shared scenes

> Miss Cornelia investigates Mary's past and learns that Mrs. [Wiley](../character/wiley.md) has died, leaving Mary an orphan once more. Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to hear [Walter](../character/walter.md) read myths and share stories. [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) arrives with the news of Mrs. Wiley's death, startling Mary, while [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) promises to pray that Mary can remain in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES

> Mary joins the children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and informs [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that they have caused a scandal by mistakenly cleaning house on Sunday. The children realize [Faith](../character/faith.md) lost track of the days because prayer meeting was moved. Afterwards, [Walter](../character/walter.md) describes his poetic vision of heaven to the group, and [Faith](../character/faith.md) assures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she has a plan to clear up the town's misunderstanding.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY

> [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md), and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss the recent funeral of [Myra Murray](../character/myra-murray.md) and gossip about local church business and parish families. [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) finishes her knitting and runs down to [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where she tells [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) about Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/davis.md) leaving the church and the potential loss of ministry salary. Horrified at the thought of having to move away from [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary, [Faith](../character/faith.md) decides she must act to convince [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) to return to the congregation.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) causes a scandal at church by attending without stockings, which leads to gossip across the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) and discussions among [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), and Miss Cornelia. In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) and [Di](../character/di.md) defend [Faith](../character/faith.md) when [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) criticizes her, but [Jerry](../character/jerry.md) and the [Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club) decide to punish [Faith](../character/faith.md) by making her wear her hated striped stockings. To clear her father's name and clarify other misunderstandings, [Faith](../character/faith.md) writes and publishes a detailed letter of explanation in the local newspaper.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION”

> [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) become terrified in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) when they mistake Mrs. [Stimson](../character/stimson.md)—who is crawling on the [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden dyke with white sheets on her shoulders looking for a knitting needle—for the ghost of [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md). Terrified, the Meredith children sprint to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), where [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) soothe them. [Susan](../character/susan.md) investigates with a pitchfork and returns to explain the embarrassing truth, prompting the children to retreat home in shame.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss the upcoming double wedding of [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and Mr. Meredith, alongside [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) and [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md). Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to celebrate Jem's final evening before he leaves for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). [Walter](../character/walter.md) poetically describes the Pied Piper calling them, and [Jem](../character/jem.md) eagerly responds that he would follow the Piper anywhere.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME”
